description: Verify that DUT does not close the TCP reliable connection when service is stopped
approach:
[Objective]
Connection lifecycle: stopping the service should not tear down the underlying TCP connection — DUT keeps the socket alive, only the SD-level offer is withdrawn.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester ⇄ DUT: TCP handshake + Method Request → Response on the reliable endpoint.
3. Tester (UT) → DUT: stop service.
4. Observation: DUT must NOT emit FIN/RST on the TCP connection.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT kept TCP connection open across service stop — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response on reliable endpoint within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_dut_emitted_fin: DUT tore down TCP reliable connection on reset
